originality: Original generated painted ground details. Each sheet was generated with this project's own ground material as the only reference; no copyrighted game images.
layout: 4x4 per ground; rows 1-2 tiny, row 3 medium, row 4 large flat features

sources.prompt:
Create an original painted asset sheet for a top-down fantasy strategy game map: a 4x4 grid of 16 separate small ground details for grass terrain, on a fully transparent background.

The attached reference image is the grass ground texture these details will be painted onto. Match its colours, lighting, brush texture, level of detail and scale exactly, so every detail looks like part of that ground and not like a sticker placed on top of it.

Layout: exactly 4 rows and 4 columns of equal square cells. Each detail is centred in its own cell with generous empty transparent space around it; nothing touches or crosses a cell boundary. No grid lines, frames, labels, numbers or text.
Sizes: rows 1 and 2 are tiny details, each filling about a third of its cell. Row 3 is medium details, about half of the cell. Row 4 is larger flat ground features, about two thirds of the cell.

Row 1 (tiny): a small clover patch; a tuft of white daisies; a few yellow buttercups; three small grey pebbles
Row 2 (tiny): a short grass tuft with seed heads; a dandelion rosette; a few fallen leaves; a tiny mushroom pair
Row 3 (medium): a patch of wildflowers in white and violet; a low mole hill of fresh earth; a mossy flat stone half sunk in grass; a ring of tiny mushrooms
Row 4 (large, flat): a worn bare earth patch with a few grass blades; a broad patch of taller meadow grass; a scatter of small stones in the grass; a soft patch of moss and clover

Style: seen from directly above like the reference texture, lying flat on the ground. Soft irregular edges that fade out into transparency. No outlines, no dark rim, no round patch or disc of ground under any detail, no cast shadows except a very soft contact darkening right under raised parts. Muted natural colours with low contrast against the reference ground. Hand painted, consistent soft daylight from the top left. Nothing that looks like a building, creature, person, treasure or item to pick up.
